summary.text: Kay Kirkpatrick, a Republican, has represented Georgia's 32nd Senate District since 2017; she was sworn in to the Senate on June 2, 2017, and is Secretary of the Majority Caucus.

paragraphs.text: Her official biography says she has been an orthopedic hand surgeon in Atlanta for over 30 years and was previously president of Resurgens Orthopedics.
Her official biography says she graduated from the University of Kentucky and earned her medical degree from the University of Louisville.
